description.value:
You always have the Nondetection spell prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can have prepared. Once per long rest, you can cast it for free.

Automated: the Fimblewood Academy module grants you Nondetection as an always-prepared spell and tracks your once-per-long-rest free casting — the first time you cast it each day, no Resonance is spent.

source.custom: Fimblewood Academy homebrew, adapted from "Unblooded Sorcery" (2026).
